title: Print flags before details in command help
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- help registry && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test registry_contracts --test output_spill

truths: single-command help prints the invoke line, the first sentence of the description, the flags block, then the rest of the description under a line that reads details:
multi-command help (--all) keeps its current shape

the descriptions of dispatch prepare, cells cap, cells finish, worktree merge, herding run, close and state set in registry_payload.json carry no decision ids and no history narration, and every behavior they state is still stated
the herding control-loop help names the roles dispatch, merge, route, supervisor and broker and no longer mentions control-loop.sh

action: Implement CONTEXT.md D9 (audit H-herding-help.md, CLI help verdict and finding 6). (1) help.rs render_help_text: for a single entry, print the description's first sentence (reuse first_sentence), then the flags block, then, when text remains, a line '    details:' and the remaining description indented. Multi-entry output stays the same. (2) registry_payload.json: in the seven named descriptions remove decision ids (D12, uat-gate-before-merge D1 and the like), issue numbers, and history phrases (legacy, now a no-op, replaced its old meaning, byte-identically to before, pre-contract), rewriting each sentence so the current behavior it states survives. Keep the JSON byte style (same separators, ensure_ascii false). (3) Fix the control-loop description: list all five roles, drop the control-loop.sh sentence and the pre-D4 narration. Update existing tests that pin old help text. No new tests (stdi-6 owns them). Proof: the cell verify; also paste the first 25 lines of .bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare --help from a fresh release build if one exists, else say it was not built. Rules for every cell: keep every rule and its why-clause (agents-block-diet D6); keep test-pinned wording unless this action names the pin; never add a size limit (D1). Write no code comments. Plain English, short sentences. Allowed bee commands: the cell verify, .bee/bin/bee knowledge check, .bee/bin/bee knowledge search. Do not run any bee dispatch or herding verb, not even its help. Run only the cell verify, never the full suite. Commit only the files of this cell, one commit, trailer cell: <id>.
